text:
sophie: Quick UX q — designing the console view for route-scoped roles. Do we show inherited grants inline or hide behind a toggle? I’m worried about clutter when teams bind 20 tiny scopes.

 dan: Inline feels noisy. Toggle labeled "show effective permissions"?

 maya: +1 for collapsed by default. Also add a small audit icon if an inherited grant came from a tenant preset. :lego: 

 arnold: We also need the API semantics to be crystal. Frontend should be able to fetch two endpoints: /v1/roles/:id (explicit grants) and /v1/roles/:id/effective (includes inherited). Maybe cache the effective result for 60s.

 sophie: I sketched a compact pill UI — pills for explicit scopes, faint pills for inherited. Hover shows origin: "tenant-preset:" or "route-binding:". Mock: https://figma.redwood.com/s/compact-scope-pills (mock)

 maya: Love the pill idea. Minor: color choices — inherited = outline only, explicit = filled. Also add a tiny "audit" badge when a policy enforces the grant.

 dan: Question for infra: should quota enforcement be evaluated against explicit only or effective? If effective, it can surprise teams who think they only have explicit grants.

 arnold: Server-side enforcement uses effective entitlements. Console should surface that clearly. I’ll add a small CTA: "This route can consume X tokens via effective grants".

 sophie: Good. For rollout we should A/B test language: "Effective permissions" vs "Inherited + explicit". Which is clearer?

 maya: "Effective permissions" is short but ambiguous. Maybe use "Effective (inherited + explicit)" the first time, then collapse to "Effective" afterwards.

 infra-bot: Note: role cache invalidated on tenant-preset change — event id 0x4f9c. Will broadcast via /ws/roles/events

 dan: API detail: for bindings we have two write flows. Current PATCH /v1/role-bindings/:id merges by default. We discussed add ?mode=replace to allow replacing all explicit grants. Sophie — do you want frontend to use replace for the new "clear and apply" button?

 sophie: Yes, for the "apply preset" flow we want replace. For manual edits use merge. Show a confirmation modal for replace.

 maya: Telemetry: add a console event for "viewed_effective_permissions" and "toggled_inherited_view" and capture role_id, route_id, and user_tier. Helps us see confusion rates.

 arnold: Also add a metric when frontend shows the audit badge — we want to know how many effective grants are enforced by policy.

 sophie: Copy. I'll update the mock and link to the API snippet.

 sophie: API example for replace:
```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/role-bindings/123?mode=replace" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"explicit_scopes": ["routes.read","routes.invoke:service-A"] }'
```

 maya: tiny nit — include the origin metadata when backend emits events so console can show "last_changed_by" and "changed_via".

 arnold: Will add changed_via in ws payload (ui, api, preset-import).

 dan: OK with rollout plan: feature flag per-tenant, start with internal tenants, then canary 10% orgs, then 100%.

 sophie: Plan sounds good. Can someone own docs and release notes?

 maya: I’ll do docs. Will stub the console help text and API doc changes.

 sophie: Thanks all. I’ll upload updated figma and follow up with a checklist: mock, API PR, telemetry events, feature flag. :thumbsup: 

 infra-bot: Deployment note: role-api v2 will be deployed to staging tomorrow 03:30 UTC — expect brief cache mismatch window.

 dan: I'll coordinate staging smoke tests.

 maya: :party:
